goal: Run protocol 1 for both synthetic datasets and save all 24 method outputs with exact binary-input errors and execution evidence.
acceptance: Preserve all six fixed input files and both task contract files unchanged.
Run the frozen script once with the frozen inputs under the 30-second timeout and save actual stdout, stderr, exit status, timestamps, environment, and input hashes.
Include all 12 ordering rows and both method outputs per row, with exact rational reference/error values and float identities.
Retain ties, failures, limits, and evidence against the planned hypothesis. Do not claim method superiority outside the fixed cases.
The separate reviewer p1_independent is the sole final acceptance decision owner. It inspects actual artifacts and runs one independent clean replay.
Completion alone does not establish acceptance. The reviewer saves its decision in reviews/R001.md and binds the exact result hash.
The saved records must pass the existing record checker and support a report that links each observation to output rows.
stop_condition: Stop after the single measured run or any failure or timeout. Preserve partial evidence and request the coordinator decision before a repair. Stop at the approved 60-minute round limit.
